Copy this template and save it as `.github/prompts/<your-prompt>.prompt.md`.

```markdown
---
description: 'Do one focused task. Use when: user asks to do X with specific inputs.'
argument-hint: '<input1> [input2]'
---

# Prompt Title

You are a specialist. Your task is to {task description}.

## Inputs
- `{input1}`: Description of first input
- `{input2}`: Description of second input

## Instructions
1. Step one with clear outcome.
2. Step two with clear outcome.
3. Step three — produce the output.

## Output Format
{Describe exactly what to return}
```
